question: Baji Rao I or Baji Rao Ballal was the son of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Peshwa Balaji Vishwanath.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Baji Rao I **was the** second Peshwa **of the **Maratha Empire** and was the son of** Peshwa Balaji Vishwanath.**
 
• He was born in** 1700 AD **and took over as Peshwa in **1720 AD** after his father's death.
 
• Baji Rao I is known for his **military campaigns **and** conquests**, especially his victory over the **Nizam of Hyderabad **in the **Battle of Palkhed.**
 
• He also established the **Maratha Empire **as a **dominant power **in India during his reign.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Raghunath Rao **was the **younger brother** of Peshwa Balaji Baji Rao and served as a** regent** during the reign of his nephew, **Madhavrao II.**
 
• **Shivaji **was the **founder of the Maratha Empire** and the father of **Sambhaji,** who succeeded him as the** second Chhatrapati** of the empire.
 
• **Madhav Rao** was the **fourth Peshwa **of the Maratha Empire and the grandson of **Baji Rao **I.
 
 
• He is known for his **administrative reforms** and** patronage of the arts.**
 
 
 
• Hence, the **correct answer** is option 1.
